attack_vectors.name: [NUCLEI] SMB - Enumeration
attack_vectors.description:
SMS Information Extraction is a sophisticated and efficient system designed to retrieve critical information from a remote computer or device through short text messages. This technology enables users to remotely access essential details about a computer, such as its operating system (OS) version, computer name, and hostname,
all via SMS communication.

attack_vectors.name: [NUCLEI] SMB - Enum Domains
attack_vectors.description: SMB enumeration of domains is often part of the reconnaissance phase, where security professionals or attackers attempt to gather information about the target network to identify potential vulnerabilities.

attack_vectors.name: [NUCLEI] SMB Version - Detection
attack_vectors.description: SMB version detection involves identifying the specific Server Message Block protocol version used by a system or network. This process is crucial for ensuring compatibility and security, as different SMB versions may have distinct features and vulnerabilities.

attack_vectors.name: [NUCLEI] smb2-capabilities - Enumeration
attack_vectors.description: Attempts to list the supported capabilities in a SMBv2 server for each enabled dialect.

attack_vectors.name: [NUCLEI] SMB Signing Not Required
attack_vectors.description: Signing is not required on the remote SMB server. An unauthenticated, remote attacker can exploit this to conduct man-in-the-middle attacks against the SMB server.

attack_vectors.name: [NUCLEI] VMware ESXi SLP - Heap Overflow DoS
attack_vectors.description: OpenSLP as used in ESXi and the Horizon DaaS appliances has a heap overwrite issue. VMware has evaluated the severity of this issue to be in the Critical severity range with a maximum CVSSv3 base score of 9.8.
